release_notes.headline: New `jelou shop metrics` command group for company-scoped Shop analytics, plus typed field schemas when creating Datum collections.

highlights.text: `jelou shop metrics` — company-scoped Shop analytics as terminal cards and charts (or JSON for agents): `overview`, `sales`, `search`, `catalog`, and `customers`. Each takes `--from`/`--to` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `--app-ids`; `sales`/`search`/`customers` also accept `--detail` for paginated row-level data.

`jelou databases collections create --field name:type[:opt=val,...]` — define a collection's field schema up front instead of adding it later in the admin UI. Repeatable; trailing `!` on the name marks a field required, and array options (select values, mime types, domains) use `|`. Unknown types or options fail before any network call.
